rationale.IWM: US small caps, deepest laggard vs mega-caps; recovered +13.6% in H2 2025 as rotation began
rationale.MDY: US mid caps, cheap broadening exposure beyond the top-10 concentration
rationale.EFA: Developed international, led breadth win in 2025-H1 (+20.5%) on weak-dollar tailwind
rationale.EEM: Emerging markets, strong 2025 run and cheap valuations vs US
rationale.EWJ: Japan, corporate reform + reflation, steady 12%+ gains across 2025
rationale.EWG: Germany/Europe, best single performer in 2025-H1 (+35%) on fiscal stimulus turn
rationale.XLF: Financials benefit from steep yield curve and broadening leadership
rationale.XLV: Healthcare, defensive laggard that snapped back +14% in H2 2025
rationale.XLI: Industrials, reshoring/capex beneficiary with consistent breadth participation
rationale.KRE: Regional banks, extreme laggard leveraged to Fed rate cuts and curve steepening

backtest.notes: Lost badly in 2024-H1 (concentration era) but beat SPY by +5pp in 2025-H1 driven by international (EWG/EFA/EEM). H2-2025 partial lagged -2.2pp but small-cap/healthcare recovery confirmed rotation entering 2026.
